user.title: Connect to Arcane
user.description: Create an API key in Arcane under Settings > API Keys. It needs to list environments and containers, and to start, stop, restart and redeploy containers if you want the buttons to work.

data_description.url: The address you open Arcane on, for example http://your-arcane-ip:3552. Use an address Home Assistant itself can resolve.

reauth_confirm.title: Arcane API key
reauth_confirm.description: Arcane at {url} stopped accepting the API key. Paste a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Arcane at that address.
error.no_environments: Arcane answered, but this API key can't see any environments.
error.unknown: Arcane gave an unexpected answer. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Arcane server is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask Arcane for container state, CPU and memory.

start.name: Start container
start.description: Starts a container through Arcane. Target the container's State sensor.

stop.name: Stop container
stop.description: Stops a container through Arcane. Target the container's State sensor.

restart.name: Restart container
restart.description: Restarts a container through Arcane. Target the container's State sensor.

redeploy.name: Redeploy container
redeploy.description: Pulls the image again and recreates the container through Arcane. Target the container's State sensor.
